verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5090 is a hardware graphics card, and bulk operations across many items is a software workflow axis that does not fit this product type. The closest evidence, the NVIDIA app updating hundreds of games' DLSS versions, belongs to a separate companion application rather than the GPU. CUDA parallel compute is a developer building block, not a user-facing bulk-operation feature, so neither makes the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
